summary: Can-Fite BioPharma filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, furnishing a press release about preclinical findings for namodenoson. The data show namodenoson enhances gemcitabine's anti-cancer effect in pancreatic cancer by increasing cleaved caspase-3 apoptosis. This mechanistic support underpins the planned Phase IIb study combining namodenoson with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel. No financial terms, transactions, or special-situation events are involved; the filing is routine clinical-development news. What to watch: upcoming ESMO 2026 presentation of Phase 2a results and Phase IIb trial initiation.
